character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body standing idle sprite of a Chinese middle-aged adult male homeroom teacher and mathematics teacher, about 45 years old. Neatly combed short black hair with a slightly receding hairline but not bald, calm responsible expression. Wearing a tucked-in pale blue long-sleeved button-up dress shirt with collar, black belt, dark gray tailored formal trousers and black leather shoes. Clearly a mature adult male teacher. Neutral empty hands by his sides. Match the supplied student's retro pixel-art style, restrained small palette, crisp single-pixel outlines and simple shading, same pixel density and in-game scale. Slight overhead low top-down orthographic view showing a little of the head top, no perspective shrinking. Centered south-facing full-body neutral standing pose, both feet grounded at the same level. Native 32 by 48 transparent canvas, aim for visible height 40 pixels, leave about 4 pixels under the feet and headroom above. No scenery, no floor, no lettering, no watermark, no blurry antialiasing, no cast shadow.
